newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends eight cents up to 14.19 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends eight cents up to 14.19 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended eight cents up at 14.19 ringgit ($5.74) a kg, despite a lower London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.
They said the higher close, aided by short-covering from European, Japanese and local interests, was also to make up for the 18 cents fall in the domestic price on Wednesday.
"Buyers probably felt the price had fallen too much," said a trader, adding that this reflected the market's fundamentals.
There were initial bids for 191 tonnes against offers for 91. Final turnover was 109 tonnes against 102 on Wednesday. The local price was at a $70 a tonne premium over London.
